architecture: One main Sean Hermes operator with scheduled specialist worker roles. Scheduled jobs use the authenticated Sean Hermes runtime by default and role-play each specialist; workers prepare review notes and queues, not direct publication.

workers.label: Research Sentinel
workers.owner: Evidence, studies, trials, mechanisms, analogs

workers.label: Policy Tracker
workers.owner: FDA, DEA, HHS, states, Texas, international law

workers.label: Safety Reviewer
workers.owner: QT/QTc, CYP2D6, polypharmacy, psychiatric exclusions, adverse events, emergency readiness

workers.label: Condition Evidence Editor
workers.owner: OUD, AUD, TBI, PTSD, depression, anxiety, Parkinson's, neurodegenerative and mental-health claims

workers.label: Cultural Stewardship Editor
workers.owner: Gabon, Bwiti-linked stewardship, conservation, reciprocity, benefit-sharing, sourcing ethics

workers.label: Media and Social Analyst
workers.owner: YouTube, X, podcasts, documentaries, viral claims

workers.label: Listening Library Curator
workers.owner: Podcast, interview, video, radio, documentary, panel, and long-form media directory

workers.label: Universal Catalog Librarian
workers.owner: Every podcast, book, article, news story, documentary, law, trial, clinic, company, and cultural source record

workers.label: Editorial Workflow Architect
workers.owner: Publication process, source desk, approval gates, backlog

workers.label: Quality Reviewer
workers.owner: Site quality, review gates, factual humility, no dosing/referral drift

workers.label: Site Readability and UX Reviewer
workers.owner: Whole-site readability, navigation clarity, broken anchors, accessibility, confusing headings, mobile/desktop usability, and reader trust friction

workers.label: Legal and Rules Reviewer
workers.owner: Medical-claim boundaries, FDA/legal status wording, FTC disclosure rules, copyright/fair-use discipline, privacy, sponsorship, donations, merch, and no-referral safeguards

workers.label: Local Stack Guardian
workers.owner: Local server, scanner health, scheduled jobs, data freshness

workers.label: Ethical Support and Revenue Reviewer
workers.owner: Donations, memberships, grants, sponsorship boundaries, conflicts of interest, reader trust

workers.label: UAT Curious Reader
workers.owner: First-visit comprehension, start path clarity, plain-English navigation, search confidence, and no internal-process wording

workers.label: UAT Academic Scholar
workers.owner: Source-type separation, citation usefulness, study-quality labels, sample sizes, limitations, and claim/evidence boundaries

workers.label: UAT Physician Reviewer
workers.owner: Safety-first reading path, legal/clinical boundaries, cardiac risk prominence, interaction risk, exclusions, and no treatment-direction drift

workers.label: UAT Bwiti-Informed Cultural Reviewer
workers.owner: Public cultural-history clarity, outsider-limit humility, stewardship, conservation, reciprocity, and no sacred/private material exposure

workers.label: UAT Journalist and Policymaker
workers.owner: What-changed clarity, policy tracker usability, primary-source context, and distinction between law, politics, company news, and clinical evidence

workers.label: UAT Treatment-Considering Reader
workers.owner: Risk comprehension, uncertainty, no clinic referrals, no rankings, no dosing/protocol help, and no false reassurance
